none: PAS NLM-4A366E: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]LENTI [---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 2.14gms, die axis: 6
